fusions.name: Cut Short
fusions.desc: A thrown cut that strikes one enemy at or below 25% health and deals 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Sweeping Arc
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone that deals 14 damage to everything caught in it and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shared Reaping
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Harvest Rhythm
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
